hooks.command: ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; cd "$ROOT" || exit 0; mkdir -p .claude/hooks-state; STATE_FILE=.claude/hooks-state/changelog.status; SIG=$( (git diff -- . ":!CHANGELOG.md" 2>/dev/null; git diff --cached -- . ":!CHANGELOG.md" 2>/dev/null; git status --short 2>/dev/null | grep -v CHANGELOG.md) ); if [ -z "$SIG" ]; then exit 0; fi; HASH=$(printf "%s" "$SIG" | cksum); PREV=""; if [ -f "$STATE_FILE" ]; then PREV=$(cat "$STATE_FILE"); fi; if [ "$HASH" = "$PREV" ]; then exit 0; fi; printf "%s" "$HASH" > "$STATE_FILE"; jq -n --arg reason "There are uncommitted changes not yet reflected in CHANGELOG.md. Before stopping, follow .claude/skills/changelog/SKILL.md: get the current date and time via the date command, write 1-5 short bullets summarizing what changed, and prepend a new dated entry to CHANGELOG.md (create it with a top-level Changelog heading if missing). Do not commit. Then finish normally." '{decision:"block", reason:$reason}'
hooks.statusMessage: Checking whether CHANGELOG.md needs an entry...
